items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button with ten variants, five sizes, five icon-only sizes and a loading state that keeps its width.

items.name: close-button
items.title: Close Button
items.description: An icon-only button that shows an X, in four sizes and a light or dark theme. Use it to dismiss a banner, panel or any surface that has no built-in close control.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label that appears on hover or keyboard focus of its trigger, with an optional description line and arrow. Use it to name an icon-only control or add a brief hint; it only holds text, so reach for a popover when the content is interactive.
